channel.title: Assigned Media – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Assigned Media – Bias and Credibility (assignedmedia.org)

item.title: Talking Trans History with a Trans Legend — Assigned
item.description: A conversation between Assigned Media and trans historian Susan Stryker.

item.title: Supreme Court Won’t Hear Case About “Parents’ Rights” — Assigned
item.description: A Massachusetts case about parents’ “right” to know if their kids are socially transitioning at school has been shot down by SCOTUS.

item.title: It's Just a House. It's Also a Revolution. — Assigned
item.description: In Western Massachusetts, Anemoni House is a first-of-its-kind LGBTQ-centered safe house, one that could model a way for many more.

item.title: TWIBS: New York Times Pretty Sure Trans Coverage is Fair, Respectful — Assigned
item.description: Brooke Williams, mom to a trans kid, asked NYT if they have plans to make it up to the trans community for years of slanted, harmful coverage. Their response suggests complete and total detachment from reality.

item.title: Hate Group Affiliated Academics Face Outcry at Medical Conference — Assigned
item.description: Leading Off: Pediatric Academic Societies platforms anti-trans academics connected with SEGM at an event panel and are met with protests. Our top headline as we start off the week.

item.title: Does The New York Times Want to Eradicate Trans People? — Assigned
item.description: An analysis of its coverage reveals a pattern of misrepresentations, deceptions, distortions, the exclusion of trans voices, and the endorsement of contempt.

item.title: How Resilient Are You? — Assigned
item.description: To thrive as a trans person in a hostile world, you’ll need resilience. What is resilience and how resilient are you, personally?

item.title: TWIBS: Iowa Lawmakers Hate Iowans — Assigned
item.description: Iowa’s state legislature has passed a bill disallowing municipal protections for marginalized Iowans, who have been abundantly clear about who they want to protect.

item.title: DIY Hub Disappears After Right-Wing Scrutiny — Assigned
item.description: Leading Off: UK based DIY HRT site, HRT Cafe, shuts down without warning; Idaho moves to restrict social transition for minors; the State Department cracks down on transgender immigrants. The top story lines as we start off the week.

item.title: New York Times Reporter Bemoans “Lack of Viewpoints” in Major Medical Journals — Assigned
item.description: Jeremy Peters took to the comments on his recent article to signal his agreement with a far-right conspiracy theory that major medical journals have been ideologically captured. The theory seeks to explain the overwhelming evidence in favor of gender-affirming treatments.

item.title: Federal Judge Considering Class Action Over Trans Troop Ban — Assigned
item.description: Judge Ana Reyes, who has rebuked the administration’s ban on trans troops more than once over the last year, has called for a briefing to discuss whether or not their case should apply to a larger group of people.

item.title: What Does it Mean to be Resilient? — Assigned
item.description: Resilience is a learnable skill, but people didn’t always believe it to be. To understand resilience, we take a look at its history.

item.title: TWIBS: Republicans Can’t Resist Poison Pill in Museum Bill — Assigned
item.description: An effort to pass legislation for a museum dedicated to women’s history in America, which has languished in congress for six years, has been dealt another blow by Republicans’ last minute anti-trans additions.

item.title: The Value of Routines and Community in Prison — Assigned
item.description: Trans and queer inmates share their experiences in finding belonging and normalcy within the bounds of a hostile prison system.

item.title: When ICE Came to Maine, Trans Mainers Fought Back — Assigned
item.description: Crystal Cron leads an immigrant mutual aid organization. Crystal is nonbinary and Latine. Jesse Holleran does coms for Equality Maine by day, and volunteers to fight ICE after work. They’re far from alone.
